tasks.description:
Phase 1. Block D-02: weekly Oracle report. Top 5 signals per domain. Purpose signal candidates. SCS-001 topic recommendations ranked by scs_relevance. Telegram delivery + JSONL archive.

Project root: /Users/tarekmnif/Documents/Voxight
Target file to CREATE: /Users/tarekmnif/Documents/Voxight/src/scripts/weekly-oracle-report.js
The script generates a weekly Oracle intelligence report: (1) query top 5 signals per domain (AI, crypto, regulation, web3) by confidence, (2) list all purpose_signal_candidate=true signals, (3) list SCS-001 topic recommendations (top signals relevant to content creation), (4) write report as Markdown to /Users/tarekmnif/Documents/Voxight/reports/oracle/YYYY-MM-DD.md, (5) also store report JSON in Supabase for API access. ES module syntax.
